policy: Fresh isolated context per first-open/search/heatmap. Normal cache+prefetch retained for next/previous. Real network and assets; no mocked APIs, throttling or answer/Note writes.
image_bytes_note: CDP encoded transfer bytes for Image requests begun during each action, including app adjacent/answer prefetch. Warm prefetched images may start before action and contribute zero; this is not a per-prompt payload size.
quantile_note: 3–5 browser samples are descriptive only; nearest-rank P95 here is the maximum and not a stable production latency estimate. Use independent larger HTTP sample for API percentiles.
